title: BEACON Region Registry
description: Validates config/regions.json (ADR-011, ADR-031; FR-ZONE-1…7; SPEC §4.2). Adding an operating region is ONE entry here plus, where needed, a catalog label and an offline seed — no source change (FR-10/FR-ZONE-3). `iso`, `tz` and `languages` are REQUIRED of every config-authored region: they were previously absent, which forced the composition root to keep a hardcoded ISO map and a duplicated bbox table, and an unknown region silently inherited California's geography (finding F-06). The domain entity keeps them optional so existing programmatic seeds and tests remain valid; config does not get that latitude.

$comment.description: Human note; ignored by the loader.

default_region_id.description: The region the COP opens on. MUST match one of the entries below (asserted by a test).

regions.description: Every operating region, in selector order.

regionId.description: Stable registry key, e.g. 'us-ca', 'ro', 'ph'. Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Restrictive on purpose: the id is used as a cache-key component (`lkg:<adapterId>:<regionId>`) and in URLs.

name.description: Operator-facing name, used in docs, audit output, and as the fallback selector label. The UI prefers a message-catalog key so the selector translates (finding F-22).

scope.description: Mirrors the region.scope CHECK constraint in the DDL — keep the values byte-identical.

iso.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code. THIS is what decides whether a country-scoped adapter (e.g. a national met service) covers the region. Sub-national regions carry their country's code (us-ca ⇒ US).

bbox.description: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] — the SINGLE source of truth for the region's extent. Every adapter query is bounded by it. There is deliberately no fallback: a region without a bbox is a configuration error, never another region's geography.

tz.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'Europe/Bucharest'). Every timestamp displayed for this region, and every CAP effective/expiry time, is formatted in it (FR-I18N-4).

languages.description: BCP-47 tags, most significant first. Outbound alerts carry the region's language(s) AND English, always (FR-I18N-6). Coverage-completeness rule: a shipped zone's primary language ships as a locale in config/locales.json.

enabled_adapters.description: Allowlist of adapter ids (from config/adapters.json) permitted for this region, IN PRECEDENCE ORDER: within one port/slot the first adapter that serves wins the slot, so this array is where a region's source precedence is declared (B1.8/ADR-012 — it is not a literal in any use-case). Every id must be a REAL manifest id — roadmap-only names in config/planned-sources.md must not appear (asserted by the drift-guard test). minItems: 1 because since B1.3 an EMPTY list means 'consult NOTHING' (finding F-54): the region would load, render and label a picture no source was ever asked about. 'Consult nothing' must be said by deleting the region, not by an empty array that reads like an accident.

source_mode_overrides.description: Per-region redundancy-mode overrides (manifest id → LIVE|CACHED|MOCK). Precedence: env SOURCE_<PREFIX>_MODE → this map → the manifest's own mode.

$comment.description: Human note on this region (e.g. why a source is forced CACHED); ignored by the loader.

boundary.description: Path, relative to the directory of regions.json, of a GeoJSON Feature or Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry: the region's actual outline (ADR-042). A served record must touch it; the bbox stays the fetch window. Natural Earth 1:50m, public domain — see NOTICE.
